description: This file defines an 'Identifier' controller class within the OpenCart administration area for managing localization identifiers. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, saving, and deleting localization identifiers, along with preparing data for views and handling user permissions.

classes.name: Identifier
classes.description: Controller class for managing localization identifiers in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to load the identifier list view with breadcrumb navigation and page setup.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to reload the list of identifiers.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the list of identifiers with pagination and links, returning the rendered HTML view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing an identifier, populating existing data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submissions to create or update an identifier, with permission checks and validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected identifiers after permission validation.
